summary: Keep historical queries retryable while their missing anchors await automatic backfill
details: Return SNAPSHOT_NOT_READY when the requested anchor is missing inside the committed pending backfill range, allowing existing bounded validation retries to recover with the original height and identity.

Keep complete historical heights available during backfill. Missing business snapshots or anchors outside the pending range remain local HISTORY_NOT_AVAILABLE faults; retention and identity mismatch checks are unchanged.
